note: City of Cherokee park on Spring Lake, near the Little Sioux River, with a 1.1-mile paved trail around the lake, playground, sand volleyball court, fishing and shelters. --Claude
summary: City page refused today (Cloudflare); confirmed from its 2026-10-16 read: $22 W/E / $25 FHU, 48+ sites, water+sewer, showers, 14-day max, $600 monthly on designated spots. Cleared 50 A and 60 ft (directory only). Waterfront lead: lakefront -> not waterfront (no RV pad on the lake). Pin is in the lake: corrected.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade lead: lakefront -> not waterfront): Spring Lake is well over 5 acres (about 450 m x 100-150 m on NAIP, several hectares), so it is a lake, but no RV pad is on it. The main row of ~17-20 angled back-ins runs along the west park road against the railroad woods, 100 m+ from the water with the road, the paved lakeshore trail, lawn with trees, a building and the playground between. A second row of ~7 back-ins by the road on the east side (around 42.7375,-95.5565) backs into a continuous tree belt about 60 m deep before the water. A few rigs stand on a gravel area at the north end by the Little Sioux River, ~40 m from it through a tree line. No city photo of a site was readable (page refused), so no view is shown either: under the 2026-11-02 rule this goes down to not waterfront (lakeview only if a site photo were found showing the lake from the west row).
PIN (in the lake): stored 42.73950,-95.55750 sits at the lake's west shoreline. The main west row centres on about 42.73982,-95.55912 (~140 m away). Proposed location 42.73982,-95.55912.

PHONE missing: the city page gives Parks & Rec 712-225-2715 ('Call 712-225-2715 in the afternoons to make reservations for the open shelters'); Campendium lists the same number for the campground. Suggest 712-225-2715.

UNREAD: the city page answered a Cloudflare challenge to curl and to the headless browser on 2026-11-03; per the brief I did not try another route. Season, reservations and amperage stay unverified. A web search summary claimed 'first come, first served', but the city text read on 2026-10-16 says FCFS only about the shelters, so nothing was written.

SITES: the city says 'over 48 camping spaces with electrical, water and sewer hookups' yet prices $22 water-and-electric sites separately, so not every site has sewer; imagery shows roughly 30 pads in the two rows plus the north gravel area.
LONG-STAY: a $600 monthly rate exists only for designated spots with the City Administrator's permission; nightly sites carry a 14-day maximum. Not a concern.
Note: removed the hookup, site-count, shower and 60-ft text the fields now hold.
